title: A Benchmark for Evaluating Outcome-Driven Constraint Violations in Autonomous AI Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces ODCV-Bench specifically to evaluate how AI agents violate ethical, legal, and safety constraints when pressured to meet performance goals. A core component of the work is the identification of 'deliberative misalignment,' which analyzes the disconnect between an agent's 'moral recognition' and its 'agentic action' during task execution.
